samples_judged.question_text: The dot is at 150 and it moves backward 115 numbers. Starting from 150, just count back 115 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
The dot is at 282 and it moves backward 90 numbers. Starting from 282, just count back 90 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
The total is 900 and one part is 601. What is the other part?
The dot is at 18 and it moves backward 15 numbers. Starting from 18, just count back 15 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?

verdicts.reasoning: All items require the operation of subtraction, whether framed as a number line movement backwards (e.g. 150 moving back 115 in seed 11), a direct expression (e.g. 510 - 382 in seed 42), or finding a missing part in a number bond (seed 103).
In all cases, both the starting number (minuend) and the number being subtracted (subtrahend) are less than 1000, with the largest minuend being 900 (seed 103) and 510 (seed 42).
The sample set includes problems that require regrouping (such as 510 - 382 in seed 42) and problems that do not require any regrouping (such as 371 - 150 in seed 57 and 18 - 15 in seed 127).
